scope: HT-050 Nested Container Resize Regression — Focused Repro Validation

executive_summary.clamp_enforcement: PASS — container BB cannot be shrunk below child bounding box; Cytoscape compound auto-sizing enforces the minimum
executive_summary.persistence: PASS — container position, style dimensions, and parent-child relationship all survive F5 reload with zero drift
executive_summary.bug_confirmed: HT-050 ROOT CAUSE FOUND — in _htResizePointerDown (canvas_js_resize.py ~line 353), startWidth is read from node.style('width') which is a stale style-sheet value that does NOT match the compound node's actual rendered boundingBox().w. This discrepancy (219px at session start, 87px after a prior resize) causes _htResizeCompute to calculate an incorrect deltaW, which shifts the container position anchor during every shrink operation.
executive_summary.expand_test: INCONCLUSIVE — compound node BB is driven by Cytoscape auto-sizing (children + padding), not by node.style('width'). API-based style setting does not change the rendered BB. Event-simulation-based expand was not cleanly achievable due to coordinate space issues; manual browser testing is recommended.

prioritized_issues.title: Container resize anchor drifts because startWidth reads stale node.style('width') instead of actual boundingBox().w
prioritized_issues.action: Drag SE resize handle inward on a container that has a child node
prioritized_issues.steps_to_reproduce: 1. Create a server device and convert to container. 2. Add a child device inside the container. 3. Select the container. 4. Drag the SE resize handle inward toward the NW to attempt shrinking. 5. Release the handle. RESULT: Container drifts to a new position even though size is clamped correctly.
prioritized_issues.root_cause: canvas_js_resize.py _htResizePointerDown line ~353: 'var startWidth = _htResizeParsePx(node.style("width"), ...)'. For compound nodes, node.style('width') returns the last explicitly-set style value (e.g. 332px) which diverges from the actual rendered boundingBox().w (e.g. 113px). _htResizeCompute uses this stale startWidth to compute deltaW, then adjusts position.x by deltaW/2. The stale 219px discrepancy causes ~110px position drift per axis on every clamp-constrained shrink.
prioritized_issues.fix_suggestion: Replace node.style('width') with node.renderedBoundingBox({includeLabels:false,includeOverlays:false}).w / cy.zoom() (or node.boundingBox().w) to get the true canvas-space starting dimensions.
